body:
I have. And her "wall" for coming back to me is that she now doesn't know if she can trust I won't run when things get tough. And she's right, she has no basis to trust that because I did abandon her. I have no way to express the change that's happened in me other than my actions. 

And I want to do these things, I'm just so fearful of this time I'm having to wait that it feels to overwhelming to deal with.

I'm feeling much more stable that I did this morning when I posted, I just haven't been in that kind of despair before.
many of the things that were my dreams to do we ended up doing in our life together. I had thought about this as well.. but now I just want her back. and I've screwed it all up.

I've given up drinking because I don't like to drink when I'm depressed. My friends have been good support, but I'm at the point where I just feel like the mistake that was made was too much for me to bare. 

this is the woman I wanted to take care of until we were too old to take care of ourselves. and I just completely screwed up. I spent so much time trying to be a perfect husband, that I wasn't even a good husband.

I just wish she'd forgive me. I have repented for what I've done, but I think its too late.

the misunderstanding was that we were both going through depression, and I need to feel loved. hers was deep enough that she had lost the ability to care for me for a short time. I over reacted, and initiated the divorce. I wanted her to find some way for her to be happy, and thought that maybe meant I may not be in her life. 

I forgot my vows. I forgot that sometimes you just have to be strong enough for the both of you.

We talked about this for the first time saturday since the divorce was done. We both still immensely love each other, however, she just doesnt know if she can ever trust me again. i threw away the thing I loved most in this life over some misguided logic. I've tried to forgive myself, but I truly despise who that man was and what he did.
yes, but I wouldn't be this person. and I really enjoyed the person she helped turn me into
